items.statement: In the practice's client herds, facilitated planning visits delivered by the herd's own vet increase the number of observed core biosecurity measures in place by at least 1.5 of 5 at six months, with at least 70 percent of visits delivered as planned.
items.rationale: Combines the adoption effect seen in the trial with a local delivery target the practice can use.
items.risks: Few herds; farms that agree may already be keener.

items.statement: Farms with spare housing adopt isolation of purchased cattle, while farms without it adopt visitor and footbath measures instead.
items.rationale: Tests whether priorities adapt to farm constraints.
